Q: Passing table content as parameter for BigQuery UDF A:

Every row in a table is a struct. You can use struct for that purpose.
However, if you want to unit test multiple rows at a time, it doesn't solve what you want.

Can you show some examples that you want to unit test?

Q: A problem with \r character added to my strings without being asked to A:

You are using: support.append('\n');

support.append('\n');

In your code for line endings,But on windows line endings {" \r\n " } ,so when you compare strings or print them , java internally shows as

"0\t\t01\t0002\r\n0003\t4\t5\r\n".

Its not any error or bug.Its a platform dependent behaviour of the code.
To avoid this platform dependent behaviour ,we have use the append method as

"support.append(System.lineSeparator());"

replace ( support.append('\n') with (support.append(System.lineSeparator());

Q: WinSCP script stops after trasferring the first file A:

Yes, this is a correct way to upload multiple files.

It does not work, because your server does not support preserving file timestamp.

You can make WinSCP not try to preserve the timestamp by adding the -nopreservetime switch to the put command.

put -nopreservetime c:\temp\*.xlsx

For more details see the documentation for the error message Upload of file .. was successful, but error occurred while setting the permissions and/or timestamp. If the problem persists, turn off setting permissions or preserving timestamp. Alternatively you can turn on 'Ignore permission errors' option.

Q: Sending Teams chat message to person/channel from java service A:

There is a way to easily send a message to a channel, but not to a direct message to a person though. To achiever so you can follow the official documentation In other words you can add/setup an incoming web hook to a channel, grab the link provided by it and use a CURL request to send a message like so:

curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"text\": \"test\"}" https://uri-provided_by_hook

Hopefully, there is no need to inform about how to execute an http request through Java code.

Q: Powershell AddAccessRule without clearing existing A:

Set the isProtected argument to $false (in this case, setting preserveInheritance has no effect either way).
